text: Professor Philip Goodman has built a television career debunking fraudulent psychics, driven by the superstition that split his family apart. His boyhood hero, a long-vanished paranormal investigator now living sick in a caravan, [gives him three cases to solve|trigger|digging into a mystery]: a night watchman in a disused women's asylum, a teenager who runs over [a creature in the woods|images|monsters and hybrid creatures], and a City financier [haunted by a poltergeist as he awaits his child's birth|who_suffers|expectant parents]. Goodman is sure each has a rational answer, until [the world around him starts to come apart|rules|reality comes apart].
